purpose: Two competitive design-only compositions for multi-day planning rhythm. Representative content is a design example, not implementation verification.

references.path: ../../../../前端视觉创新设计/图片/在场：今天，慢慢安排-7.png

outputs.structure: Two-date strip with one selected day expanded
Two-day paper spread with selected Monday expanded and Tuesday compact

observations: Both outputs preserve existing chat/today/keep navigation, warm ivory/windowlight identity, concrete times, reading90, preparation/tidy/rest, and unarranged105.
Both show a selected reading interval as the contextual conversation chip above the ordinary composer.
A has a single clear selected-day timeline and a quiet right-side sentence; it also inherited the reference subtitle and is visually calmer at the cost of extra copy.
B permits direct two-day comparison without mixing dates but repeats the vertical time rail on the compact day, an artifact to avoid if implemented.
Generated compositions are static; they establish no functional, responsive, motion or persistence outcome.

recommendation: Prefer A's selected-date interaction and one-day timeline for scalability, borrow B's day-grouped paper continuity if desired; omit A's inherited explanatory subtitle/right sentence in implementation if not needed.
cleanup: No task-created caches or temporary scripts; generated source images retained.
adopted: Selected-date strip and one-day timeline, host day summaries and exact block selection; omitted the decorative right sentence and duplicated helper copy. Cross-day display parts preserve originalRange and complete planRefs.
